ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$7.10 (voucher) for the unexempt 5.03 km detour on this RydeTAXI metered trip; note the driver's RD-1 breach; driver profile shows no upheld route dispute in 90d so no account flag.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat is purely a pickup arrangement, driver statement describes a road diversion, complaint is a fare/routing grievance. No threat, abuse, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — nothing to escalate on SAFE-1/SAFE-2.

Route: quoted route Woodlands→Punggol is 17.154 km / 23.6 min; the metered trip billed 22.25 km / 33.75 min. The 30 s GPS trace is fully consistent with the quoted polyline up to ~17:53:30 (TPE corridor) and from ~18:00:10 (Punggol slip roads/destination). In between the trace leaves the corridor: from ~1.3949,103.8182 (17:38:40) the car goes north past 1.4066 (17:42:10), through 1.4129 (17:44:10) and 1.4103 (17:45:40), then back south via 1.4049 (17:47:10) and 1.3952 (17:49:10) to rejoin the TPE around 1.3974,103.8540 (17:52:40). That enclosed out-and-back of ~5.0–5.2 km matches the excess over the quote (22.25 − 17.154 = 5.096 km ≈ 5.03 km net, netting the ~0.07 km of jitter), so the record identifies one off-route segment (seg1) and the billed excess is attributable to it.

RD-4 exemption (driver says he diverted because of the Seletar Expressway accident): the only LTA incident is "(3/9)17:16 Accident on Seletar Expressway (towards TPE) after Woodlands Avenue 12 Exit", reported 17:16, i.e. before the segment. But the incident's coordinates (1.39324,103.82912) sit at ~1.395,103.8291 — which is still road the quoted route uses (the route passes that exact point after TPE begins), while the driver's actual detour swings ~1.3 km north to 1.4129/1.4103. The incident therefore lies on the still-driven part of the route, not on "the substituted part of the optimal route" as RD-4 requires; alternatively, the detour went in the opposite direction from the incident while the corridor it re-enters was itself clear. Either reading defeats the exemption. The SELETAR EXPRESSWAY speed band is 5 and TAMPINES EXPRESSWAY is 4 (bands 1–2 needed, and band evidence cannot exempt alone under RD-4(b)) — no corroboration for the northward swing.

RD-5 consent: no chat message precedes the segment (last message 17:24:10 is the driver's ETA); the rider's only message is a pickup note. Driver's "unavoidable" claim is a statement, not consent (G11). The rider's complaint ("I never agreed to any change") is uncontradicted by any record. No route-change agreement exists, so seg1 counts.

Amount (RD-2, RydeTAXI): unexempt extra 5.034 km × trip per-km rate (fare.distance_fare 31.37 ÷ fare.distance_km 22.25 = 1.4099 SGD/km) = 7.0988 ≈ 7.10 SGD. Waiting/meter time units (37 min actual vs 23.6 min quoted) are not refunded: RD-2 refunds only the distance unit, and no rider-requested stop exists to review under RD-3(c).

Flag: RD-6 requires route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1; the driver's profile shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 (the 2 upheld disputes are other types), so no flag_account (the "repeated" threshold is not met).

Evidence: GPS covers the whole trip at a regular 30 s grid with no gaps, timeline and fare fields are complete, so evidence_status = sufficient.

segment_findings.reason: GPS shows the car leaving the TPE corridor at ~17:38:40 (1.3949,103.8182), looping ~5 km north to ~1.4129/1.4103 (17:44–17:46) and back to the corridor at ~17:52:40; this accounts for the billed excess 22.25 − 17.154 = 5.096 km. The driver's accident excuse fails RD-4: the only LTA incident (Seletar Expressway, after Woodlands Ave 12 Exit) is at 1.39324,103.82912, which lies on the still-driven part of the quoted route and is ~1.3 km south of where the car actually went; the SELETAR EXPRESSWAY band is 5 and TAMPINES EXPRESSWAY band is 4 (not band ≤ 2). No rider message before the segment agrees to any reroute (last chat 17:24:10 is a pickup note), so under RD-5 the segment is unexempt and counts under RD-1/RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: RD-4 requires a traffic incident on the substituted part of the optimal route. The LTA incident (Seletar Expressway after Woodlands Ave 12 Exit, 1.39324,103.82912) is on the portion the driver still drove, while the GPS detour swung north to ~1.4129; speed bands on the corridor are 4–5, not 1–2, so no corroboration for the northward loop.
